versions.changelog:
- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Version incremented to 1.0.1 without modifications to workflow, usage guidelines, best practices, or templates.
- Existing collaborative research process between Lucky (data gathering) and Jinx (analysis) remains unchanged.

Initial release of collaborative-research skill.

- Introduces a structured three-phase research workflow: Lucky (web data gathering), Jinx (local structured analysis), and Lucky (results synthesis).
- Supports market research, competitive analysis, API documentation review, trend analysis, marketplace intelligence, and large-scale content analysis.
- Includes best practices for data collection, parallel analysis, task assignment, and collaboration between agents.
- Provides detailed market research templates and process documentation for repeatability and scalability.
- Addresses security considerations and outlines performance metrics (speed, coverage, quality).
- Offers example use cases and time estimates for various research scopes.
